response.changelog:
Pixel OS v2.1.3-b3 — Opt-In iOS Style UI Beta on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Fixed Home Screen Left/Right Swipe Cross-Flash & Top Status/Notification Bar Pull-Down (v1.7.5-ios26): eliminated opposite-sheet crossfade/RenderNode flash on left & right Home Screen swipes and added display-level SPY gesture monitoring + transient-bar touch-steal recovery so pulling down from the top status/notification bar reliably opens Notification Center (left) and Control Center (right) everywhere
• Fixed iOS 26 Lock Screen Pull-Up & Notification Center Bleed-Through (v1.7.4-ios26): eliminated stock Android NotificationShade flash, double-animation snap-back, blank wallpaper stall, task-close black bar, and duplicate Notification Center pull-down over Lock Screen — delivering smooth 90Hz finger-tracking unlock straight to the Home Screen
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (< 80 MiB — no 1.81 GB full system re-download required!)
• Fixed Websites Not Opening in Chrome, Brave & Chromium Browsers: stripped Qualcomm vendor init.target.rc 'stop statsd' and hardened zygote_next's native species library (libzygote_species_android_native.so) so isolated Chromium renderer zygotes (*_zygote_native / NativeOnlySandboxedProcessService0) never abort on closed /dev/socket/statsdw FDs
• Zero-Freeze Cold App Startup & 4.14 eBPF/DNS Networking + Out-of-the-Box 4K60 Gyro-EIS3 Video Stabilization
• Full iOS 26 Liquid Glass Suite (Opt-In Beta Channel): 90Hz Liquid Glass Dock, iOS 26 Lock Screen / Notification Center / Control Center, IosSettings, iCall 26, IosMessages, and iOS Styler
